series.title: Storybooks
series.description: Illustrated storybooks that welcome children and families into Hawkins Hollow through gentle adventures, familiar feelings, and shared reading time.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Warm illustrated read-aloud stories where everyday feelings, relationships, and growing-up moments become child-owned opportunities for kindness, communication, and repair.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Invites young children and grown-ups into gentle, beautifully illustrated adventures rooted in friendship, family, and ordinary child-world moments.
presentationAuthority.audience: Picture-book and Pre-K-K-friendly shared reading with simple vocabulary, strong repetition, clear feeling words.
presentationAuthority.promise: Emotionally safe, relationship-centered story where a child meets a real but manageable challenge and practices communication, repair, belonging, patience, or gentle problem-solving.

editorial.welcomeText: If this is your first visit to Hawkins Hollow, this story is a gentle place to begin.
editorial.experienceText: Gentle illustrated adventures that introduce Hawkins Hollow one memory at a time.

series.title: First Readers
series.description: Simple, encouraging stories for children beginning to read with a helper.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Beginning-reader stories that build confidence with carefully controlled text, clear pictures, and real Hawkins Hollow adventures shaped around foundational reading skills.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Give children a welcoming place to begin reading with greater independence through short pages, small cast, clear illustrations, and story-native sound/word/sequence work.
presentationAuthority.audience: Beginning readers and read-together settings where a child is starting to take an active role in reading.
presentationAuthority.promise: Clearly defined foundational reading skill inside a coherent, emotionally safe story, avoiding random word lists, crowded scenes, or worksheet disguised as a book.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories use simple language for children beginning to read with a helper.
editorial.audienceText: Beginning readers and the grown-ups reading beside them.
editorial.experienceText: Short, approachable stories with steady pacing and confidence-building repetition.

series.title: Second Readers
series.description: Longer stories for children growing in reading confidence and independence.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Three-chapter early reading adventures where a mystery, problem, question, or missing piece gives children a reason to read farther and think more deeply.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Early chapter-book stories for children ready to stay with a question across a longer adventure, following clues and working through a child-sized mystery.
presentationAuthority.audience: Children ready for longer, more independent early chapter-book reading, with clear chapter structure and manageable continuing cast.
presentationAuthority.promise: Held together by a real child-sized mystery, problem, investigation, question, or evidence chain where the lead child's understanding changes through observation and participation.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories offer richer detail and longer paths for growing readers.
editorial.audienceText: Readers ready for broader adventures and deeper story threads.
editorial.experienceText: More independent reading with warm support from familiar Hawkins Hollow friends.

series.title: Basic Training
series.description: Skill-building stories that help children practice habits, confidence, and everyday courage.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Practical, story-driven adventures that help children feel more capable by noticing, trying, adjusting, and participating in the ordinary work of everyday life.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Turns useful everyday skills into warm adventures where the story creates a real need to participate, with children watching characters choose tools, try tasks, and discover they can help.
presentationAuthority.audience: Ages 4-8, designed for family read-alouds, beginning independent readers, homeschooling families, and caregivers seeking confidence-building practical stories.
presentationAuthority.promise: Embeds one useful real-world skill inside a genuine Hawkins Hollow need, with the child owning the attempt, adjustment, self-check, and accomplishment.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories support everyday skills through caring characters and practical moments.
editorial.audienceText: Families helping children practice everyday readiness and resilience.
editorial.experienceText: Guided stories for growth, confidence, and healthy routines.

series.title: Growing Together
series.description: Stories about belonging, cooperation, and family relationships that deepen over time.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Substantial stories in which children discover wiser ways to participate in relationships, community, health, nature, and everyday life through lived experience.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Follows children into real situations involving friendship, fairness, responsibility, leadership, inclusion, belonging, health, nature, routines, and community care.
presentationAuthority.audience: Substantial 6x9 three-chapter reading experience for children able to follow a longer social or everyday-life situation.
presentationAuthority.promise: Begins with a meaningful lived situation, deepens through discovery, and ends with the lead child practicing a wiser way to participate.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories help families grow through kindness, listening, and shared effort.
editorial.audienceText: Families who want encouragement around belonging and cooperation.
editorial.experienceText: Heart-forward stories about care, patience, and growing together.

series.title: Bedtime Library
series.description: Quiet stories for winding down and ending the day with reassurance.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Quiet evening stories that gently lower the energy of the day and help children move from awake toward sleep-ready through rhythm, routine, place, and trusted closeness.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Brings the Hollow to evening pace with one last thought, object, question, routine, or look at the settling world carrying a child toward enough, quiet, and rest.
presentationAuthority.audience: Children listening with a trusted grown-up during the transition from daytime activity toward rest, with low-density text and quiet pacing.
presentationAuthority.promise: Lowers emotional, verbal, and visual energy from beginning to end, with settling rather than solving plot and closeness, reassurance, and readiness for rest.

editorial.welcomeText: Slow down, settle in, and choose a story for the end of the day.
editorial.audienceText: Children and caregivers looking for gentle stories before rest.
editorial.experienceText: Calm pacing and reassuring endings for shared bedtime moments.

series.title: Tender Times
series.description: Comforting stories for moments when children need reassurance, connection, and care.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Emotionally honest stories that help children carry worry, sadness, change, waiting, missing, or uncertainty with safe companionship instead of rushing the feeling away.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Offers children a warm place to meet difficult feelings without being hurried toward a happy answer, through honest language, small participation, and steady relationships.
presentationAuthority.audience: Children experiencing or exploring child-safe worry, sadness, change, waiting, missing, disappointment, absence, or tender uncertainty through shared reading with a trusted adult.
presentationAuthority.promise: Lowers aloneness rather than simply reducing feeling, with the child emotionally central, receiving one small truthful way to participate, and supported without being asked to fix the hard thing.

editorial.welcomeText: These stories were written for moments when children need reassurance, comfort, and connection.
editorial.audienceText: Families moving through change, big feelings, or difficult days.
editorial.experienceText: Comfort-centered stories that make room for healing and hope.

series.title: Holiday Story Poems
series.description: Seasonal poems and celebrations that mark special days in Hawkins Hollow.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: Warm holiday stories told in verse, created to be read aloud, shared, and remembered.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Invites children and families into complete seasonal, holiday, family, and community stories told through gentle narrative verse and cinematic watercolor-and-ink illustrations.
presentationAuthority.audience: Families celebrating seasonal traditions and gatherings.
presentationAuthority.promise: Complete holiday and seasonal stories told through warm verse, with each child-centered read-aloud journey exploring kindness, courage, responsibility, memory, wonder, or belonging.

editorial.welcomeText: Follow holidays and traditions through story poems written for shared reading.
editorial.audienceText: Families celebrating seasonal traditions and gatherings.
editorial.experienceText: Festive story poems that invite reflection, gratitude, and joy.

series.title: Hero Play Poems
series.description: Imaginative poems where children explore courage, play, and pretend adventures.

presentationAuthority.oneLineDescriptor: True moments from history remembered through story, poetry, and a small Hawkins Hollow stage.
presentationAuthority.shortDescription: Introduce young readers to real historical men and women through one defining, age-appropriate moment from each person's life, with the Hawkins Hollow cast presenting each memory as a small respectful community play.
presentationAuthority.audience: Young children and families, educators, librarians, and caregivers who want an emotionally safe first doorway into history.
presentationAuthority.promise: Honors one real historical figure through one accurate, age-appropriate defining moment, keeping history primary and carrying the hero's human quality into one concrete Hawkins Hollow action.

editorial.welcomeText: These poems celebrate imagination, bravery, and playful adventure.
editorial.audienceText: Children who love pretend play and imaginative storytelling.
editorial.experienceText: Rhythmic poems that inspire confidence and creative exploration.
